```yaml
name: OpenData Commitment Eligibility

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint PowerShell Scripts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Install PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: pwsh -Command "Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser"

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: pwsh -Command "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Severity Warning,Error | Format-Table -AutoSize"

  test:
    name: Run Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Install Pester
        run: pwsh -Command "Install-Module -Name Pester -Force -Scope CurrentUser"

      - name: Execute Pester Tests
        run: pwsh -Command "Invoke-Pester -Path .\Tests -Output Detailed"

  deploy:
    name: Manual Deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://example.com
    steps:
      - name: Manual Approval Required
        run: echo "Deployment requires manual approval. Please review the changes before proceeding."

      - name: Deploy to Production
        run: echo "Deploying to production environment..."
```
